capabilities: Convert a Day One JSON export into Markdown notes
Import inline images and videos from entries
Write tags, starred/pinned flags, location, and activity to frontmatter
Report failed imports in a Failed Imports.md file
Configure the target folder and file naming through settings
extras: Limitations are listed: customizable metadata formats and weather data are not currently planned. Failed entries are written to a Failed Imports.md file with the error reason, such as filename conflicts. The README notes a third-party dependency (Zod, MIT license).
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to bring Day One journal entries, their media, and metadata into a vault.
summary: Imports Day One journal JSON exports into Markdown notes with inline media and entry metadata written to frontmatter.
